articles.text: Baseball is a game between two teams of nine players each, under direction of a manager, played on a closed field in accordance with these rules, under jurisdiction of one or more umpires.

rules.title: Improper Play, Illegal Action, and Misconduct

articles.text: If there is a runner, or runners, it is a balk when the pitcher, while touching his plate, makes any motion naturally associated with his pitch and fails to make such delivery.
